description: Issue #35 stage 1, V2 gate (LANG parameter): runs the real TXLEGACY *CMD (tools/qcmdsrc/txlegacy.cmd) and *PGM (tools/qclsrc/txlegacy.clp, LANG(*SAME/*RPG/*RPGLE), TXLEGLNG, LOADRPGLE) against the library, through the helper LGLRUN (src/lglrun.clp: QCMDEXC with LANG and FORCE, a 3-parameter CALL mode and a TXLEGLNG/TXLEGST report mode; all parameters declared with real lengths, so the 32-byte CALL/PARM literal trap does not apply). It needs the git-clone tree, so the shipped sources are placed in $HOME/ibmi-kyozai exactly as verify/part05-txlegacy-exec does (file step into scratch members LL*, then CPYTOSTMF with STMFCCSID(1208) to src/legacy/...), now including src/legacy/qrpgle112/*.rpgle (HAND CONVERSION - UNVERIFIED until part05-lgcvt and part05-lggold have been read). part05-txlegacy-exec stays as it is and must be rerun separately to prove the RPG III one-way path did not regress (expect its own result: done, RPG III, OBJATTRIBUTE RPG). ORDER (one wrapper job): gate (LGPRE, as in part05-lggold), compile LGLRUN, TXLEGACY (*PGM, *CMD), RUNTXRESET, snapshot A-PRE (OBJATTRIBUTE and OBJCREATED of JU0300, ZA0500, TK0100, JU0900C, MN0000C, TXLEGST, TXLEGLNG; TXLEGLNG values come as LGLRUN SNAP messages in VFYLOG, tagged the same). Then TXLEGST and TXLEGLNG are deleted so the next call is a genuine first load without a backup, and: R1 LANG(*RPGLE) (first load), R2A LANG omitted and FORCE omitted (*SAME, already loaded), R2C LANG(*RPG) FORCE(*NO) (mismatch), R2D the old 3-parameter CALL of the TXLEGACY program with FORCE *NO (MCH3601 path), R2B LANG(*SAME) FORCE(*YES) (rebuild, language kept), R3 LANG(*RPG) FORCE(*YES), R4 LANG(*SAME) FORCE(*YES) (again), each followed by SNAP and an OBJECT_STATISTICS snapshot with the same tag. Then restore: the fixed JU0900C (QCLSRC member JU0900F copied over JU0900C, program recompiled), TXLEGLNG deleted (the state before issue 35 had none, and *SAME treats a missing area as *RPG), TXRESET, snapshot Z-FINAL. EXPECTED (all UNVERIFIED, 2026-10-01): R1: messages loading ... then TXLEGACY: done.; OBJATTRIBUTE RPGLE for JU0300, ZA0500, TK0100, CLP for JU0900C and MN0000C; TXLEGLNG=[*RPGLE]. R2A: TXLEGACY: already loaded in this library (no rebuild: OBJCREATED unchanged from R1, TXLEGLNG still *RPGLE), no note line. R2C: the already loaded message plus the note line that the loaded language is *RPGLE, not *RPG and that nothing was changed (OBJCREATED unchanged; the note shows blank padding after the language names, because the CL joins them with *CAT, cosmetic). R2D: the already loaded message and NO MCH3601 escape and no "stopped on an unexpected error" line: that is the proof that the missing 4th parameter is treated as *SAME; no note line either (LANGU resolved to *RPGLE). R2B: a backup line (LG<QDATE> SAVF in <USER>B; the SAVOBJ may fail with the SAVF already holding data, which TXLEGACY monitors), loading ..., done.; OBJATTRIBUTE still RPGLE, OBJCREATED newer than R1, TXLEGLNG=[*RPGLE]. R3: OBJATTRIBUTE RPG for the three programs, newer OBJCREATED, TXLEGLNG=[*RPG]. R4: OBJATTRIBUTE RPG, newer OBJCREATED, TXLEGLNG=[*RPG]. Z-FINAL: RPG, CLP, no TXLEGLNG row, TXLEGST present. Reading gate: every full load must end with a line starting TXLEGACY: done. in VFYLOG; TXLEGACY catches its own errors and returns normally, so the helper step never shows FAILED for it (see part05-txlegacy-exec). Four full loads (R1, R2B, R3, R4) compile 7 objects each, hence the long ssh timeout. Side effects: <USER>B gets a SAVF LG<QDATE> (backup role, TXLEGACY FORCE(*YES) always writes it); the clone tree gets untracked src/legacy files (see part05-txlegacy-exec for the git-working-tree caveat); scratch source members LL* stay in QRPGSRC, QRPGLE112, QDDSSRC, QCLSRC. Nothing in this batch has run on hardware (PUB400 unreachable on 2026-10-01).

steps.label: GATE
steps.cmd:
CALL PGM(&LIB/LGPRE) PARM('&LIB')
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 MCH0000) EXEC(GOTO CMDLBL(DONE))

steps.label: MKOBJ
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYLGOBJ (TAG VARCHAR(20), OBJNAME VARCHAR(10), OBJTYPE VARCHAR(8), OBJATTRIBUTE VARCHAR(10), OBJCREATED TIMESTAMP)') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: OBJA
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYLGOBJ SELECT ''A-PRE'', OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJCREATED FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*ALL'')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN (''JU0300'', ''ZA0500'', ''TK0100'', ''JU0900C'', ''MN0000C'', ''TXLEGST'', ''TXLEGLNG'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: MKR1
steps.cmd: SNDPGMMSG MSGID(CPF9898) MSGF(QCPFMSG) MSGDTA('LGLANG MARK R1 first load LANG(*RPGLE)') TOPGMQ(*SAME) MSGTYPE(*INFO)

steps.label: OBJR1

steps.cmd: SNDPGMMSG MSGID(CPF9898) MSGF(QCPFMSG) MSGDTA('LGLANG MARK R2B LANG(*SAME) FORCE(*YES)') TOPGMQ(*SAME) MSGTYPE(*INFO)

steps.label: OBJR2B
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYLGOBJ SELECT ''R2B-SAMEF'', OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJCREATED FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*ALL'')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN (''JU0300'', ''ZA0500'', ''TK0100'', ''JU0900C'', ''MN0000C'', ''TXLEGST'', ''TXLEGLNG'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: MKR3
steps.cmd: SNDPGMMSG MSGID(CPF9898) MSGF(QCPFMSG) MSGDTA('LGLANG MARK R3 LANG(*RPG) FORCE(*YES)') TOPGMQ(*SAME) MSGTYPE(*INFO)

steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYLGOBJ SELECT ''R3-RPG'', OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJCREATED FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*ALL'')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN (''JU0300'', ''ZA0500'', ''TK0100'', ''JU0900C'', ''MN0000C'', ''TXLEGST'', ''TXLEGLNG'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: MKR4
steps.cmd: SNDPGMMSG MSGID(CPF9898) MSGF(QCPFMSG) MSGDTA('LGLANG MARK R4 LANG(*SAME) FORCE(*YES) again') TOPGMQ(*SAME) MSGTYPE(*INFO)

steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYLGOBJ SELECT ''R4-SAME'', OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJCREATED FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*ALL'')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN (''JU0300'', ''ZA0500'', ''TK0100'', ''JU0900C'', ''MN0000C'', ''TXLEGST'', ''TXLEGLNG'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: MK90
steps.cmd: SNDPGMMSG MSGID(CPF9898) MSGF(QCPFMSG) MSGDTA('LGLANG MARK 90 restore fixed JU0900C, drop TXLEGLNG, TXRESET') TOPGMQ(*SAME) MSGTYPE(*INFO)

steps.label: RSCPYF
steps.cmd: CPYSRCF FROMFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) TOFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) FROMMBR(JU0900F) TOMBR(JU0900C) MBROPT(*REPLACE)

steps.label: RSJU09
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0900C)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0900C) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(JU0900C) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: OBJZ
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYLGOBJ SELECT ''Z-FINAL'', OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJCREATED FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*ALL'')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN (''JU0300'', ''ZA0500'', ''TK0100'', ''JU0900C'', ''MN0000C'', ''TXLEGST'', ''TXLEGLNG'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.sql: SELECT TAG, OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJCREATED FROM &LIB/VFYLGOBJ ORDER BY TAG, OBJNAME
